messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert INC-2026-845 — High SSE tail latency detected in us-west-2 streaming cluster. Paging oncall: @maya
maya: Copy. Investigating mux/usw2 cluster. Seeing sustained tail latency ~4s, some pods hitting high GC and open file limits.
james: Which service is the biggest offender? mux-proxy or streaming-proxy?
maya: streaming-proxy-3 and mux-proxy-7 showing highest queues. Quick log snippet:
```json
{ "pod": "streaming-proxy-3", "95th_latency_ms": 4200, "in_flight": 128 }
```
james: That looks like KV cache churn + client fanout spikes. Could be a burst of long-running chat sessions. If we keep streaming on, latency will keep climbing.
kevin: Short-term options: tighten global streaming rate limit, or temporarily flip streaming -> polling for affected region. Polling costs more tokens but reduces push overhead.
elaine: Support: we need a customer-impact list before we turn anything off. Which API keys / customers are maintaining long-lived SSE?
maya: Pulling high-connection keys... top offenders: cust-ACME, cust-ForgeAI, cust-MapleLabs. I'll tag support.
nina: Support notified top 10 customers via DM. Preparing template advisory.
maya: Proposed immediate mitigation (30m window):
- apply temporary rate-limit to anonymous/low-tier keys (1rps)
- disable streaming responses in us-west-2 for all non-enterprise customers
- increase polling quota for affected customers by 2x for 2 hours
This should lower mux fanout quickly.
james: Sounds good. Roll plan? Need deploy-bot + oncall approval.
maya: Deploy command ready: `redwoodctl traffic toggle --region usw2 --feature streaming --state off --scope non-enterprise --reason "mitigation: high SSE tail latency"`
deploy-bot: Command received. Applying change to mux group B -> streaming disabled for target scope.
deploy-bot: Change applied: streaming=false (us-west-2, scope=non-enterprise). Propagation ~15s.
maya: Seeing immediate improvement in tail latency on streaming-proxy-3: 95th down to ~600ms. In-flight connections decreasing. :thumbsup:
elaine: Draft advisory: "We've temporarily paused streaming responses in US-WEST-2 to stabilize latency for all customers. Clients will automatically fall back to polling. We're increasing poll quota for affected customers and will re-enable streaming once stable. Apologies for the disruption; reach support for exceptions." Sending to top customers now.
nina: Top customers notified. Three acknowledged and opted into temporary polling increase.
sre-manager: Document mitigation in incident ticket, set follow-up actions: longer-term KV cache tuning, autoscaling rules for mux, and client advisory automation. Assess 2h window before canary re-enable.
kevin: I'll run quota adjustment: `quotactl adjust --region usw2 --customers cust-ACME,cust-ForgeAI,cust-MapleLabs --poll-multiplier 2 --ttl 7200`
maya: Handing off monitoring to james (next oncall). I'm off for rotation.
james: Taking over. I'll watch tail latency, mux queues, and customer callbacks. Will post metric updates every 15m.
incident-bot: INC-2026-845 acknowledged by james. Pager closed (mitigation in place).
